measures.name: Ny Estimerat Antal Månader
New_Ålder
measures.expression:
VAR AsOf =
    COALESCE ( MAX ( 'Kalender'[Datum] ), TODAY() )
VAR Birth =
    SELECTEDVALUE ( 'ViewDimAnställdSCD2'[Födelsedatum] )
-- Gate: visa bara ålder där det finns fakta i nuvarande filterkontekst
VAR HasFact =
    NOT ISBLANK ( [New_FTEFöreJustering] )    -- ex: [New_FTE]
RETURN
IF (
    NOT HasFact || ISBLANK ( Birth ),
    BLANK(),
    VAR Years  = YEAR ( AsOf ) - YEAR ( Birth )
    VAR AsMD   = 100 * MONTH ( AsOf )  + DAY ( AsOf )
    VAR BrMD   = 100 * MONTH ( Birth ) + DAY ( Birth )
    RETURN Years - INT ( AsMD < BrMD )
)

measures.name: New_LönetilläggAntalMånader
measures.expression:
VAR HasFact = NOT ISBLANK ( [New_FTE] )              -- din faktamätare
VAR Y         = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'Kalender'[År], YEAR ( TODAY() ) )
VAR YearStart = DATE ( Y, 1, 1 )
VAR YearEnd   = DATE ( Y, 12, 31 )

VAR EmpStart =
    MINX ( VALUES ( 'ViewFactFte'[Lönetillägg Startdatum] ),
           DATEVALUE ( 'ViewFactFte'[Lönetillägg Startdatum] ) )
VAR EmpEndRaw =
    MAXX ( VALUES ( 'ViewFactFte'[Lönetillägg Slutdatum] ),
           DATEVALUE ( 'ViewFactFte'[Lönetillägg Slutdatum]  ) )
VAR EmpEnd = COALESCE ( EmpEndRaw, DATE ( 9999, 12, 31 ) )

VAR S = MAX ( EmpStart, YearStart )
VAR E = MIN ( EmpEnd,   YearEnd )
VAR SameMonth = NOT ( YEAR (S) <> YEAR (E) || MONTH (S) <> MONTH (E) )

VAR DaysS = DAY ( EOMONTH ( S, 0 ) )
VAR DaysE = DAY ( EOMONTH ( E, 0 ) )

VAR StartPart =
    IF ( SameMonth, BLANK(), DIVIDE ( DaysS - DAY ( S ) + 1, DaysS ) )
VAR EndPart   =
    IF ( SameMonth, BLANK(), DIVIDE ( DAY ( E ), DaysE ) )
VAR MiddleFullMonths =
    MAX ( 0, DATEDIFF ( EOMONTH ( S, 0 ) + 1, EOMONTH ( E, -1 ), MONTH ) + 1 )
VAR SameMonthFrac =
    IF ( SameMonth, DIVIDE ( DAY ( E ) - DAY ( S ) + 1, DaysS ), 0 )

VAR TotalMonths =
    IF ( SameMonth, SameMonthFrac, StartPart + MiddleFullMonths + EndPart )

VAR Result = 
IF (
    NOT HasFact
        || ISBLANK ( EmpStart )
        || S > E
        || TotalMonths <= 0,
    BLANK(),                                      -- <- viktig: inga nollor
    MIN ( 12, TotalMonths )
)

RETURN IF( Result <> 0, Result)
